name: vLLM request prefill (pre-first-token) time histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: request_latency. Split from the whole request rather than attributed to the phase, which is what makes it usable for diagnosing where a TTFT-vs-ITL regression came from.
